contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ GLOR IA[EXERCITVS]

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), GLORIA EXERCITVS issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR IA[EXERCITVS]. In exergue: dot over crescent, PLG for first officina, Lyons mint. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 17.1mm, Weight: 1.94gms, die axis: 12
